name: Tendou Juri
source:
Justice Blade 1
The Leader of the Justice Blade as Justice Phoenix, Juri is the daughter Shizuka they have a professional and close relationship. She is also a close friend of Hyoudou Azumi who she treats as a sister.

Justice Blade 2
Depending on the route Juri role will be diffrent
If Juri is corrupted she joins Earth Jade as Phoenix Jade, she kills her former teammate Justice Crocodile Jin, her betrayal causes a deep wound to her mother and deep grudge from Azumi for the death of Jin.

If Azumi is corrupted the Juri personality changes by the betrayal of Azumi
